# Fixture robots.txt for the healthy site. Everything is allowed; the named
# AI-bot groups exist so the AI-readiness scanner sees an explicit policy and
# does not report the robots-ai-policy minor. There is no Sitemap line on
# purpose: the scanners then fall back to /sitemap.xml on the current origin,
# which keeps this file independent of the ephemeral test-server port.

Allow: /

Allow: /
